purpose: Fixed intended-source labels for lexical baseline and later H comparison. Labels describe desired relevance, not a guarantee of lexical matches. Holdout must not drive tuning.

notes.title: HT-928 retry policy
notes.body: For HT-928 set client.retry.count to 3. Preview with pine --dry-run. Configuration lives at /etc/pine/config.toml. Version v2.4.1 uses exponential backoff.

notes.title: Feynman Technique / 费曼学习法
notes.body: Explain an idea in simple language to another person. Find gaps, return to the material, and explain again. 通过向别人解释概念来检查理解，发现知识缺口。

notes.title: Local backup routine
notes.body: Export a canonical JSON backup before replacing a library. Store a second copy on an external drive. A browser profile is not a backup.

notes.title: Unicode source anchors
notes.body: 🧠中文 offsets count Unicode code points. Keep café and decomposed accents unchanged in source text. UTF-16 offsets are different from code-point offsets.

notes.title: Deployment checklist
notes.body: Run tests, build the package, inspect permissions, then deploy. Use --dry-run before changing production. Roll back when the health check fails.

notes.title: Bread fermentation
notes.body: Let the dough rise slowly overnight in the refrigerator. Cold fermentation develops flavor and makes the schedule flexible.

notes.title: Focus session
notes.body: Set a timer for twenty five minutes. Work on one task. Take a short break before the next session.

notes.title: Recover a Git commit
notes.body: Use git reflog to find a lost local commit, then create a branch at its hash. Do not reset the only working copy before inspecting the log.

notes.title: SQL index inspection
notes.body: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN shows whether SQLite uses an index. A covering index can avoid a table lookup.

notes.title: 绿茶冲泡
notes.body: 绿茶用较低水温冲泡，避免苦涩。先温杯，再放茶叶，短时间浸泡。

notes.title: Idempotent saves
notes.body: Persist the receipt and note in one transaction. Retry the same request ID after a lost acknowledgement. A reused ID with a changed payload must fail.

notes.title: Windows workspace path
notes.body: The workspace is C:\work\pine\settings.json. Keep file paths and dotted.name identifiers intact.
